pages.text: Press $(k:use) on the $(item)capstan$() to drop the anchor: she stops dead. Hold $(k:use) to heave it back up. Let go before it's all the way up and it unwinds again, so keep heaving.
$(l)The anchor turn:$() drop the anchor at speed with the wheel hard over and she pivots on the spot. Handy for a tight turn, or to swing her guns round in a fight.
The bigger ships' anchors are heavier. Their capstans have more bars: three on the Brigantine, four on the Galleon, and every crewmate on a bar heaves it up faster.
